figures.finding: Uruguay's Wage Council for Group 18, subgroup 09 (artists), chapter on independent non-advertising audiovisual production, agreed on 1 October 2018 minimum pay for actors and technicians nationwide, signed for workers by the Sociedad Uruguaya de Actores, Gremiocine and the technicians' unions and for employers by ANDEBU and ASOPROD; it ran 1 July 2018 to 30 June 2020 and raises the minimums 25% for a film without an ICAU national or co-production certificate.

figures.finding: SUA's minimum rates for film and TV from January 2026 are a fee of $135,563 for a lead, $110,798 for a co-lead, $61,480 for a supporting part, $16,944 for a small part of up to two days ($33,890 from three days) and $4,691 for a featured extra, each plus a $4,691 day rate, in Uruguayan pesos including statutory items; the engager adds 11.125% for employer health contributions and the cooperative's costs, and a day runs up to 10 hours with at most 2 hours' overtime.

value.shortFilm: 10% of the feature fee plus a $2,345 day
value.mediumLength: 50% of the feature fee plus a $2,625 day

figures.finding: For advertising, SUA's January 2026 minimums for image and voice are $25,420 for a lead for one month's use ($39,100 for a year), $20,324 for a co-lead and $15,224 for a secondary part, before VAT; work outside Montevideo's media is 50% less.

figures.finding: The actors' union is the Sociedad Uruguaya de Actores (SUA), founded in 1941, a founding union of the PIT-CNT and a member of the International Federation of Actors; one joins by contacting its team.
